title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 15:00 UTC on 5 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日 15:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 15:00 UTC on 5 October 2026. The 15:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 15:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 2.33/2P). Last-180 maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-10-05T14:03:00Z; label 3Z). Published-window maximum is 3.33 (first at 2026-10-05T10:57:00Z; label 3P). Window starts 2026-10-05T10:57:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 3.33. The 16:00 UTC hour is incomplete (55 samples through 16:54).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
